description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. D. M. J. Kumarasiri, Mr. Y. W. Piyadasa and Mr. S. Waniganetti of the one part and Ceylon Electricity Board of the other part
